lastResponse.text: You need emergency medical help now. Call nine one one immediately. I’ll repeat: nine one one. If you can, unlock the door and sit on your side while you wait. If you cannot call, hand the phone to someone nearby and have them call nine one one for you now.
originalTexts: You need emergency medical help now. Call **911** immediately. I’ll repeat: **9-1-1**. If you can, unlock the door and sit on your side while you wait. If you cannot call, hand the phone to someone nearby and have them call **911** for you now.
